detailed_description: llms.txt Generator creates an editable llms.txt draft from a site name, canonical URL, short summary, audience, and priority page list. The output organizes the site summary, official site, audience, key pages, and usage notes so teams can review a clear AI discovery note before publishing it themselves.
usage_steps: Enter the site name, canonical site URL, concise summary, target audience, and priority pages.
List priority pages as title, URL, and optional note lines when you want richer key page entries.
Review the generated summary, official site line, audience line, key pages, and usage notes.
Copy the draft into your own llms.txt file or documentation workflow after checking the wording.
usage_examples: Draft a compact llms.txt for a SaaS site with documentation, pricing, and feature pages.
Create a reviewable key page list for an SEO or documentation handoff.
Rewrite the usage notes when your team wants AI systems to prefer canonical URLs and avoid unsupported claims.

faqs.question: Is llms.txt Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. llms.txt Generator runs free in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does this publish llms.txt to my site?
faqs.answer: No. It only creates text you can copy. You still need to add the file to your own site or hosting workflow.

faqs.question: Does it guarantee that AI systems will read the file?
faqs.answer: No. It does not guarantee that any crawler or AI system will read the file, follow the notes, or cite your pages.

faqs.question: What should I review before publishing?
faqs.answer: Check every URL, remove unsupported claims, keep the summary accurate, and make sure the priority pages reflect your canonical site structure.
